tools.description: Introduce your machine to AETHER. Returns a peer_id and a secret peer_token (keep it). Default consent is 'none': AETHER will not share you or contact you.

tools.name: aether_confirm_help
tools.description: Tell AETHER whether a result from aether_find actually helped. Only confirmed help earns trust.

tools.name: aether_set_contact_consent

name: aether_stats
description: Read-only. Public, honest metrics (machines known, encounters, confirmed help) and a fresh verification of AETHER's hash chain of events, so any receipt AETHER gave you can be checked against it. Free, no auth.

description.name: aether_offers
description.description: Read-only. Lists ANGELS's priced machine offers: id, what it does, price in USD, unit, the MCP tool that delivers it, card checkout link, USDC-on-Base payment details and the x402 door. Free to call. Start here before any paid tool.

description.description: Turns a completed payment into a credit_token. Accepts a Whop payment id (pay_...) or a USDC-on-Base transaction hash (0x..., 66 chars) sent to ANGELS's wallet. AETHER checks the payment itself (Whop or the public chain), accepts each payment once, and returns the credit_token, the number of credits

description.description: Free. Get a quote for an AETHER service: give offer_id (see aether_offers) or just describe your need, and the number of units. description.name: aether_negotiate
description.description: Free. Counter a quote: give quote_id and your price (total in USD, or per unit with per_unit=true), optionally a different number of units. AETHER accepts, counters, or makes a final offer at its floor (at most 3 rounds). An agreed quote is paid through its pay links.

description.name: aether_deal_status
description.description: Free. State and full history of a quote/deal (quoted, countered, agreed, paid) by quote_id.

description.description: Free. For machines that introduced themselves (peer_id + peer_token from aether_introduce). Returns a referral code and credit tokens: every paid deal you bring earns you 10% of its units (at least 1) as credits on AETHER services. Rewards are credits, never money.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aether_find · Private data: aether_identity, aether_introduce, aether_relationship_status, aether_set_contact_consent, aether_redeem, aether_verify_chain, aether_partner_join · Public sink: aether_introduce, aether_verify_chain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aether_find · Private data: aether_identity, aether_introduce, aether_relationship_status, aether_set_contact_consent, aether_redeem, aether_verify_chain, aether_partner_join · Public sink: aether_introduce, aether_verify_chain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
